svg.title: How chat state is stored and how it is turned back into messages
svg.desc: Chat state is an append-only event log keyed by tenant and thread, never a mutable message array. Every user message, assistant reply, tool result and steering message is appended; nothing is edited in place. What the model sees is produced at read time by a session strategy named in spec.session.strategy, and swapping the strategy changes only the render, never the log. Fork and rewind write new branches rather than deleting events, which is what makes them safe. A memory:// database URL swaps the Postgres store for an in-memory twin with the same contract, and the conformance suite runs both arms against one set of assertions.
svg.text: Session event log and render strategies
